title: 35 lbs (15 kg) semi dumbbell flies for 12
summary: Lift clip of semi dumbbell flies with 35 lb dumbbells for 12 reps. Per the description, he adds them on arm day to pump the pecs, get extra horizontal pressing volume without taxing the shoulders, and stretch the pecs for mobility and recovery. The audio is only background music.
